stimulus.body: Dans un exercice de français, le professeur demande de choisir la forme qui convient d'après la règle de la leçon.

questions.stem: At a staff meeting, a planner reviews the evidence: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.text: The passe compose, because visiting is completed
The imperfect, because it is a habitual backdrop
The plus-que-parfait, because it precedes now
The present, because we still love them

questions.explanation: A habitual summer visit is background, so the imperfect fits. The key is B, "The imperfect, because it is a habitual backdrop". Option A ("The passe compose, because visiting is completed") is wrong: treats habit as single event. Option C ("The plus-que-parfait, because it precedes now") is wrong: misreads prior state. Option D ("The present, because we still love them") is wrong: breaks the past frame.

questions.stem: In a reading group, a planner reviews the evidence: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.text: She used to drink coffee every morning
She has drunk coffee today
She will drink coffee tomorrow
She drank coffee this morning

questions.explanation: Used to drink coffee every morning presents a habit. The key is A, "She used to drink coffee every morning". Option B ("She has drunk coffee today") is wrong: present perfect, not past habit. Option C ("She will drink coffee tomorrow") is wrong: future, not past. Option D ("She drank coffee this morning") is wrong: single event with this morning.
questions.hint: Used to plus frequency marks a habit.
